description: This file implements an event queue using a linked list data structure, managing scheduled tasks with timestamps, callbacks, and parameters. It provides functionality to insert tasks, retrieve the next event time, execute pending tasks, and maintain the queue. The code is part of a firmware project, likely for embedded systems, handling timing and event scheduling.

classes.name: scheduling_s
classes.description: A data structure representing a scheduled event with callback, timestamp, and parameters.

classes.name: EventQueue
classes.description: A class managing a linked list of scheduled events, supporting insertion, retrieval, execution, and management of the event queue.

methods.name: insertTask
methods.description: Inserts a new task into the queue at the appropriate position based on its scheduled time.

methods.name: checkIfPending
methods.description: Checks whether a specific scheduling object is pending in the queue.

methods.name: getNextEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the earliest pending event that is not in the past.

methods.name: executeAll
methods.description: Executes all pending scheduled tasks up to the current time, calling their callbacks.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of scheduled events in the queue.

methods.name: setLateDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay used for late event handling in getNextEventTime.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the head of the linked list representing the queue.

methods.name: getForUnitText
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled event at a specific index for unit testing.
